title: Curriculum library
description: NCERT textbooks are shown to every institute by default. Use this only to limit them to certain boards or classes, or to hide them.
pickAtLeastOne: Nothing selected — every board and class will show.
hint: Leave this off to show every textbook. Turn it on to show only the chosen boards and classes; turning it on with nothing selected shows everything. No credits are involved.
